info.title: Iris Chase Actions API
info.description: Actions API for Iris Chase assistant to send notifications and create calendar events. Use these actions when the user asks to send messages, emails, or schedule events.

post.summary: Execute an action like sending a Slack message, email, or creating a calendar event
post.description: This endpoint handles three types of actions: send_slack_message (for Slack notifications), send_email (for email notifications), and create_calendar_event (for calendar events). Choose the appropriate action_type based on user intent.

action_type.description: The type of action to execute. Use 'send_slack_message' when user wants to send a Slack message. Use 'send_email' when user wants to send an email. Use 'create_calendar_event' when user wants to schedule or create a calendar event.

message.description: The message content to send. Required for send_slack_message and send_email actions. This is the body text of the Slack message or email.

recipient.description: Email address of the recipient. Required only for send_email action.

subject.description: Email subject line. Optional for send_email action. Defaults to 'Message from Iris Chase' if not provided.

event_details.description: Details for creating a calendar event. Required for create_calendar_event action.

title.description: The title/name of the calendar event

start_time.description: Start time of the event in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-01-20T10:00:00Z)

end_time.description: End time of the event in ISO 8601 format

description.description: Optional description or notes for the event

attendees.description: Optional list of attendee email addresses

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Optional API key for authentication. Set ASSISTANT_ACTION_API_KEY in Supabase secrets to enable.
